The idea that a frog will stay in a pot of water as it is slowly heated until it is boiled is a popular metaphor, but it is not scientifically accurate. In reality, frogs are sensitive to temperature changes and will try to escape if the water becomes uncomfortably hot. However, the metaphor is often used to illustrate how people might not notice gradual changes that are harmful. Among the options, the one that matches the common (though incorrect) version of the story is that the frog will stay in the pot until it is boiled.

Answer: A
